claims.claim: Raised 2026 EBITDA/DCF guidance and CCL Stage 3 completion remain the strongest reusable execution signals; no newer material primary evidence was required to restate them.

factors.name: raised 2026 guidance
factors.basis: Management raised current-year adjusted EBITDA and distributable cash flow expectations.

factors.name: CCL Stage 3 completion
factors.basis: Project completion converts construction risk into operating capacity.

risks.risk: Expansion economics remain exposed to construction discipline, approvals, contracts/spreads and feedgas availability.

contradictions.claim: GAAP net-loss volatility coexists with strong adjusted EBITDA.
contradictions.resolution: Derivative/accounting volatility must be separated from operating economics.

unknowns.unknown: Pending expansion timing, economics and future realized LNG margins remain unknown.

claims.claim: Higher guidance and completed trains support execution, while future expansion should remain contingent rather than pre-counted.

factors.name: execution conversion
factors.basis: Completed Stage 3 capacity and raised guidance are realized milestones.

risks.risk: Future projects can face capex, regulatory, feedgas and financing pressure.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental financing mix and realized expansion returns remain unknown.
